purpose: Measure the already frozen Qwen3.6-35B-A3B semantic commit policy on a substantially larger fourth source-disjoint GPT-OSS-120B MMLU-Pro set.
scientific_classification: prospective 1023-row confirmatory extension after a positive third-set confirmation; no policy, checkpoint, prompt, decoding, threshold, reliability rule, or success criterion is reselected

frozen_policy.reliability_rule: If semantic selection chooses revision and that revision is empty or max-token-exhausted, deterministically retain unchanged.

source.selection_rule: lowest SHA256(seed NUL identity) after excluding the public screen, every prior Q36 external identity, and all three prior source-disjoint GPT-OSS confirmation sets

execution.score_phase: single dependent CPU job after all candidate generation
execution.analysis_phase: single dependent CPU job after sealed selections and score

predeclared_success.capability: selected correct count is strictly greater than unchanged
predeclared_success.retention: selected retains at least 95 percent of unchanged-correct identities
predeclared_success.benchmark_success: selected correct count is nonnegative versus unchanged on MMLU-Pro
predeclared_success.strict_confirmation_pass: capability and retention and benchmark_success are all true

prohibitions: no policy, threshold, veto, source seed, prompt, decoding, checkpoint, shard identity, or success-gate change after this freeze
no selector or GPT-OSS revision retraining
no assessor access during source preparation, draft generation, GPT generation, or selection
no duplicate healthy generation, selection, or score job
no reuse of any identity from the public screen, prior Q36 source, or three prior confirmations
